description: This file defines the AnnounceFetcher class, a service for fetching and processing announcements from an external JSON feed in a Drupal module.

classes.name: AnnounceFetcher
classes.description: Service class for fetching and processing announcements from an external feed, with methods for validation, filtering, and caching.

methods.name: fetchIds
methods.description: Returns an array of IDs of all announcements in the feed.

methods.name: isRelevantItem
methods.description: Checks if a given version string is relevant to the current Drupal version.

methods.name: validateUrl
methods.description: Validates if a URL is controlled by drupal.org.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Fetches announcements from cache or remote source, filters, sorts, and maps them into Announcement objects.
